correctness.rationale: Using independent uniform clocks for displayed order, retained items are strict preference-record minima. Adjacent q-swap a above b to b above a changes only their indicators; transposition of the two clocks and integration over 0<t<s<1 isolates a telescoping set of intermediate p-rank contributions. The exact expectation decrement is 1/[r(r+1)], r=1+|S union A|>=1, independent of intermediate-rank count. Adjacent inversion removal/addition gives unique q=p upper and q=reverse(p) lower; independent insertion ranks give H_m-H_m^(2) and 1-H_m^(2). Independently computed exact rational direct enumeration for all q and all uniform displays n=2..5, including n=4 range [-61/144,95/144], and checked adjacent swap identities. This is a finite stress test of the analytic proof, not a claim of exhaustive n.
